## Closing — acute incident resolved; durable prevention delegated

**Disposition: CLOSED, class `env_integration` (operational/integration incident), no `caused_by`.**

**Acute resolved.** The `/var/gerrit` data-disk fill (sustained ≥93%, peak 94% ALARM) is
cleared. Root cause of the fill was one-off Aug-26 investigation evidence debris dumped on the
Gerrit DATA volume (`rebar-quiet-window-evidence/` epoch-probe dirs, ~5.2G each), plus earlier
retired divergent ticket clones. Operator-approved SSM reclaim on 2026-08-30 removed the stale
evidence: **19G/50G (37%) → 7.1G/50G (15%), ~11.9G freed** (the earlier stopgap had already
taken 47G→18G by removing the 30G retired clones). CloudWatch
`rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high` = **OK** since 2026-08-29T13:35 PDT and stayed OK; review-bot /
Gerrit containers healthy; no live store touched, no history rewrite, no `--force`.

**Prevention delegated.** Follow-up 3e92-b7f4-dede-4c17 (scowlful-bovine-dragonfly), linked
`discovered_from` this ticket, guards against investigation evidence ever landing on
`/var/gerrit` and adds the missing data-disk reclaim runbook. The slower residual store-GROWTH
driver (tickets-branch enrichment fan-out, blob-inclusive on-disk store) is a SEPARATE root
cause already tracked in 4520 / 536b / 0754. No active acute work remains on this ticket.

**Attribution rationale.** This was an operational/infra disk-fill incident from
evidence-debris accumulation on the gerrit box — not a shipped source-code defect on a specific
introducing commit. The RCA comments do not attribute the acute fill to a single introducing
commit/ticket; the durable growth cause is delegated to 3e92/4520/536b/0754. Attribution is
therefore by scope-of-work (env/ops), so closing `env_integration` with no `caused_by`.
